You'll need to be on the latest steam version. Outdated or "other" versions of the game will never be supported

Hey! First, thanks for the pull request!
Could you explain what this launch arg improves? What are you now able to do that you could not do before?

I thought it would allow for the steam in-game overlay but that's not it (the d3d9.dll, so remix itself, is preventing that)

> Hey! First, thanks for the pull request! Could you explain what this launch arg improves? What are you now able to do that you could not do before?
> 
> I thought it would allow for the steam in-game overlay but that's not it (the d3d9.dll, so remix itself, is preventing that)

Okay, I think there is no an approach to enable in-game overlay without clicking "Start game" button in Steam. As you know, Steam always inject its overlay in the game when Steam as an agent that starts your game. What I want is to join online game (despite only non-VAC servers). If you start `left4dead2.exe` outside of Steam, the game won't connect Steam service, results in no any workshop addon will be loaded, you can't search servers or lobbies and create a lobby (I don't know whether `connect Server_Address` works). Parameter `-steam` can resolve this.
Thanks for explaining this! I've just reworked the launcher because of the false-positives and it now comes with a config file that allows you to tweak commandline arguments.
